title: erwincoumans/motion_imitation
abstract:
Code accompanying the paper "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals"

# Motion Imitation Further development (new features, bug fixes etc) happen in the master branch. The 'paper' branch of this repository contains the original code accompanying the paper: "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals", by Xue Bin Peng et al. It provides a Gym environment for training a simulated quadruped robot to imitate various reference motions, and example training code for learning the policies. [ ](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lKYh6uuCwRY&feature=youtu.be&hd=1 "Learning Agile Robotic Locomotion Skills by Imitating Animals") Project page: https://xbpeng.github.io/projects/Robotic_Imitation/index.html ## Getting Started We use this repository with Python 3.7 or Python 3.8 on Ubuntu, MacOS and Windows. - Install MPC extension (Optional) `python3 setup.py install --user` Install dependencies: - Install MPI: `sudo apt install libopenmpi-dev` - Install requirements: `pip3 install -r requirements.txt` and it should be good to go. ## Training Imitation Models To train a policy, run the following command: ``python3 motion_imitation/run.py --mode train --motion_file motion_imitation/data/motions/dog_pace.txt --int_save_freq 10000000 --visualize`` - `--mode` can be either `train` or `test`. - `--motion_file` specifies the reference motion that the robot is to imitate. `motion_imitation/data/motions/` contains different reference motion clips. - `--int_save_freq` specifies the frequency for saving intermediate policies every n policy steps. - `--visualize` enables visualization, and rendering can be disabled by removing the flag. - the trained model and logs will be written to `output/`. For parallel training with MPI run: ``mpiexec -n 8 python3 motion_imitation/run.py --mode train --motion_file motion_imitation/data/motions/dog_pace.txt --int_save_freq 10000000`` - `-n` is the number of parallel. ## Testing Imitation Models To test a trained model, run the following command ``python3 motion_imitation/run.py --mode test --motion_file mo

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：开源了论文配套的 Gym 仿真环境与训练代码：给定一段动物参考运动片段（如 dog_pace.txt），用强化学习（如 PPO）训练四足机器人策略去模仿该动作，支持可视化与 MPI 多进程并行训练，并可在 train/test 模式间切换。


# 一、动机

> 四足机器人要获得敏捷、自然的运动技能，传统上依赖手工设计控制器或大量真实世界试错数据，成本高且难以覆盖多样步态；该工作希望利用动物参考运动作为先验，让机器人通过模仿自动学习运动策略。


# 二、方法

> 开源了论文配套的 Gym 仿真环境与训练代码：给定一段动物参考运动片段（如 dog_pace.txt），用强化学习（如 PPO）训练四足机器人策略去模仿该动作，支持可视化与 MPI 多进程并行训练，并可在 train/test 模式间切换。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 仓库提供多种动物参考运动片段（motion_imitation/data/motions/ 下的 dog_pace 等），支持 mpiexec -n 8 的并行训练；策略与日志写入 output/ 并按 int_save_freq 定期保存中间策略。摘要未给出量化性能数字，论文原版在仿真中实现了对多种动物步态的模仿并迁移到真实四足机器人（详见项目页与论文）。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：性能依赖参考运动质量与仿真保真度，sim-to-real 迁移需要额外处理，且未在本摘要中给出量化对比。启发：以动物运动作为参考进行模仿/运动重定向，是让机器人快速获得自然步态的高效范式，与具身智能、跨形态运动迁移课题高度相关。
